verdict.rationale: The gateway supports failover/retry across providers, per-provider timeouts for fast failover, and ordering/sorting of providers (docs-3, docs-9, docs-10, docs-13, docs-20, docs-29), which can mitigate a single provider's rate limits by shifting traffic elsewhere. However, there's no documented mechanism for spreading load across multiple API keys for the same provider, nor any explicit request queuing/throttling feature to smooth bursts against rate limits. Missing for 10: multi-key load balancing, explicit request queuing/throttling controls, and any rate-limit-specific documentation or independent verification.
